The engine lays a beach wherever the ground meets deeper ground, with no command asking for it — 187 tiles here. That is land against shallows and shallows against open water as well as land against open water, so a shallows band out to sea is edged on both of its sides. A create_terrain command can choose which terrain the beach is for its own tiles with beach_terrain.
